description: Return Mexico's FIX dollar rate by determination date, the rate to settle dollar obligations payable today (dolar_para_pagos: the FIX published in the DOF the previous banking day) and the 28-day TIIE from Banxico. Use dolar_para_pagos for invoices and payments in Mexico; use latam_indexacion for UDI. Free demo with a daily quota; production volume: GET /mx/indicadores via x402.
